description: Southern Teknaf Camps - Foodpaths and Roads is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by REACH Initiative. Recognizing an information gap within existing road network datasets in the Southern Teknaf camps of Coxs Bazar District (Camps 24-27 and Nayapara Registered Camp), REACH dispached field teams to the area for a roads and paths mapping exercise from November 14-15, 2018. Coverage: Bangladesh. The portal files it under the publisher REACH Initiative. Its tags are geodata, refugee crisis. It offers 1 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2024-05-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODC-ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
